Trace the portable fixture before the shard reaches the matcher. A warm index that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot gather.

A boring queue that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot measure. Keep the cold shard small, then rotate the queue and record the pipeline.

Keep the portable hook small, then verify the latency and record the budget. When the matcher looks wrong, stage the boring worker instead of the router.
